items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: I think I read something that made me think of Don Menza

ctx.x: Yes. You’ve got to do it quick.

Yeah. I think I read something that made me think of Don Menza, some anecdote about you being in a practice room at a college and someone telling you to get out of there so someone could play some serious music.

That’s true. That’s Dr. Edward Gildane. That’s not a put down because he looked in the room, opened the door and said, “I’m giving you the hairy eyeball. Let somebody serious about music practice in here.” Now having said that, if I went back in time and listened to myself practice I would have thrown myself out, you know? But you’ve got to start somewhat, you know what I mean?
